typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination1_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		EFFDATE as timestamp,
		CLIENT_NBR as string,
		BR_ACCOUNT_CD as string,
		GL_ACCOUNT_CD as string,
		ISO_CURRENCY_CD as string,
		SIGNED_AMOUNT as string,
		SIGNED_QTY as string,
		account as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource1
OLEDBSource1 derive({Copy of ACCOUNT} = account,
		{Copy of CLIENT_NBR} = CLIENT_NBR,
		{Copy of BR_ACCOUNT_CD} = BR_ACCOUNT_CD,
		{Copy of ISO_CURRENCY_CD} = ISO_CURRENCY_CD,
		{Copy of GL_ACCOUNT_CD} = GL_ACCOUNT_CD) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		ISO_CURRENCY_CD as string,
		SIGNED_QTY as integer,
		BR_ACCOUNT_CD as string,
		GL_ACCOUNT_CD as string,
		EFFDATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		CLIENT_NBR as string,
		SIGNED_AMOUNT as integer,
		account as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		ISO_CURRENCY_CD,
		SIGNED_QTY,
		BR_ACCOUNT_CD,
		GL_ACCOUNT_CD,
		EFFDATE,
		CLIENT_NBR,
		SIGNED_AMOUNT,
		account),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination1_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination1
